description_en: Retrieves information about protected object groups using pagination
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-resource-groups --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-wwo3600000i --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDefenseResourceGroups

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to view the current WAF instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the protected object group that you want to query. Fuzzy query is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的防护对象组名称。您可以设置该参数，模糊查询已创建的防护对象组
parameters.name: group_name_like

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第 1 页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20, which indicates 20 entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为20，表示每页包含 20 条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The names of the protected object groups that you want to query. Separate multiple names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的多个防护对象组。您可以设置该参数，查询多个已创建的防护对象组，多个防护对象组之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: group_names

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

Groups.description_en: The list of protected object groups

Description.description_en: The description of the protected object group

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the protected object group was created. Unit: milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 防护对象组的创建时间。单位：毫秒

GmtModified.description_en: The most recent time when the protected object group was modified. Unit: milliseconds
GmtModified.description_zh: 防护对象组的修改时间。单位：毫秒

GroupName.description_en: The name of the protected object group

ResourceList.description_en: The names of the protected objects that are added to the protected object group. Separate multiple protected objects with commas (,)
ResourceList.description_zh: 防护对象组加入的防护对象名称集合，多个防护对象之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
